system_state_snapshot.recent_sales_summary: Aucune vente. Le systeme est en phase de mise en place des moteurs de production.
open_issues: Generation d'image: HF ne sert plus FLUX/SDXL gratuitement, Gemini image = 429 (payant), AI Horde bloque depuis les IP GitHub Actions (403). Seul Pollinations repond mais qualite brute.
Pistes image en cours: Together AI (gratuit, FLUX-schnell + img2img) et Cloudflare Workers AI (gratuit 10k neurons/j) a tester; Runware en PAYG plafonne 20€ comme option qualite/volume.
Cerveaux: modele Gemini experimental deprecie corrige, fallback multi-modeles ajoute.

proposals.name: HEMA (Historical European Martial Arts) Practitioners
proposals.buyer_persona: Historical sword fighting practitioners who obsess over 15th-century fight manuals (Liechtenauer, Fiore, Meyer), buy expensive gear, and love historical memes.
product_angles: HEMA training logbook and sparring tracker (KDP)
Stickers with ironic medieval manual illustrations and insider jokes (Redbubble)
SVG vector packs of accurate historical sword silhouettes for club t-shirts (Etsy)

proposals.name: Ham Radio (Amateur Radio) Operators
proposals.buyer_persona: Older, tech-oriented hobbyists who build their own antennas, collect QSL cards, and communicate globally via Morse code or digital radio modes.
product_angles: Amateur Radio Operator Log Book with vintage technical grid pages (KDP)
Patent art posters of historic radio components (Redbubble)
Morse code cheat-sheet stickers and vintage radio schematics (Redbubble)

proposals.name: Speleology & Cave Diving (Cavers)
proposals.buyer_persona: Extreme outdoor enthusiasts who map underground cave systems, risk their lives in tight squeezes, and use highly specialized equipment.
product_angles: Caving survey log and cave mapping coordinates notebook (KDP)
Stickers with humorous caving warnings and technical typography (Redbubble)
SVG bundle of cave topography icons and karstic formations (Etsy)

proposals.name: Low-Poly Retro PS1-Style Game Developers
proposals.buyer_persona: Indie game developers building retro horror or sci-fi games in Unity/Godot, looking for fast, stylized, low-poly 3D assets that fit the 90s aesthetic.
product_angles: Low-poly vintage office equipment or retro computer terminal 3D asset pack (Cults3D / Itch.io)
Parametric retro computer monitor generator file (Cults3D)
proposals.first_test_product: PSX Retro Tech 3D Low-Poly Asset Pack (Cults3D / Itch.io)

proposals.name: Local Craft Breweries (Micro-brasseries françaises)
proposals.buyer_persona: Small local craft brewers in France who need professional, localized, vintage-style label elements or taproom decor on a budget.
product_angles: SVG bundle of vintage beer badges, hop elements, and localized French heraldry templates (Etsy)
Print-on-demand vintage metal sign designs for taproom decoration (Redbubble/Etsy)
Tasting flight logbooks for brewery taprooms (KDP)
proposals.first_test_product: Vintage French Brewery SVG & Vector Asset Pack (Etsy)

proposals.name: Hydroponics & Soil-less Urban Gardeners
proposals.buyer_persona: Urban apartment dwellers optimizing Kratky, DWC, or NFT hydroponic setups, obsessing over water pH, electrical conductivity (EC), and nutrient ratios.
product_angles: Hydroponic system parameter tracker and nutrient log book (KDP)
3D-printable custom net-pot adapters, reservoir clips, or hose organizers (Cults3D)
Minimalist aesthetic stickers for mason jar herb setups (Redbubble)
